title: Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing

Its strength-to-weight ratio is 45% better than steel, making it the most widely used titanium alloy in aerospace, medical, and industrial applications.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)

faq.q: What is a titanium seawater strainer housing?
faq.a: A titanium seawater strainer housing is a precision-machined marine piping component used in seawater strainer basket outer housing. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V ELI for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium seawater strainer housing?
faq.a: Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing is designed for seawater strainer basket outer housing. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V ELI grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium seawater strainer housing manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing is manufactured using Ring forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium seawater strainer housing?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
